Game Overview

Synapse Flux puts players into a puzzle experience centered on quick, browser-based gameplay.

How to Play

Getting started in Synapse Flux doesn't take long to learn. Jump in, follow the on-screen goal, and aim to beat your own best result each run.

Related FAQs

What is Synapse Flux?

Synapse Flux is a free puzzle game you can play instantly in your browser, with no download required.

Is Synapse Flux free to play?

Yes, Synapse Flux is completely free to play in your browser on GameBurst — no download or installation needed.
